name: pdfluent-extract
description: PDFluent Extract API as MCP tools: PDF to markdown, text, tables, chunks and structured data, plus search and document info. Documents are sent to api.pdfluent.com; calls are paid in prepaid credits.

api_key.title: PDFluent API key
api_key.description: Create a key in the PDFluent console at pdfluent.com. It is sent to api.pdfluent.com as the x-api-key header and stored in your system keychain.
